title.zh: 卷十二 本紀第十二 仁宗四
title.raw: 卷十二 本紀第十二 仁宗四 Volume 12 Annals 12: Renzong 4

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸卯，以歲饑，罷上元觀燈。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day guimao: because of famine, the Lantern Festival viewing was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, guimao: famine canceled the Lantern Festival.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命近臣同三司較天下財賦出入之數。

translations.literal: Day renzi: close officials were ordered jointly with the three departments to compare empire-wide revenue and expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, intimates and the three departments audited national income and spending.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，出內庫絹五十萬，下河北、陝西、河東路，以備軍賞。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiashen: five hundred thousand bolts of palace silk were sent to Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong for military rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiashen: half a million bolts of palace silk went to the north for army rewards.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，詔季秋有事於明堂。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuzi new moon, edict: in late autumn there was to be a rite at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon wuzi: a late-autumn Bright Hall rite was ordered.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以大慶殿為明堂。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Daqing Hall was made the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Daqing Hall became the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣官祈雨。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: officials were sent to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, officials prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，月犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the moon trespassed on the great star of the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the moon crossed the Chariot’s great star.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔明堂禮成，群臣毋上尊號。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, edict: when the Bright Hall rite was complete, ministers were not to offer honorific titles.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, ministers were forbidden honorific titles after the Bright Hall rite.

sentences.zh: 庚子，契丹遣使以伐夏師還來告。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Khitan envoys returned from campaigning against Xia and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Khitan envoys back from the Xia campaign reported.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, it rained.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔兩浙流民聽人收養。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: refugees of the two Zhes might be adopted by whoever would take them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhe refugees could be taken in by any household willing.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士趙概報使契丹。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Zhao Gai was envoy to report to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin reader Zhao Gai went as envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丁亥朔，新作明堂禮神玉。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day dinghai new moon: the Bright Hall spirit jade was newly made.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon dinghai: new Bright Hall spirit jade was cast.

sentences.zh: 己亥，旌定州義民李能。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the righteous commoner Li Neng of Ding prefecture was honored.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Ding’s righteous Li Neng was commended.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，出新制明堂樂八曲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiwei: eight new Bright Hall ritual music pieces were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiwei: eight new Bright Hall ritual tunes were issued.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以自製黃鐘五音五曲，並肄于太常。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the self-composed yellow-bell five tones and five pieces were rehearsed at the Court of Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the emperor’s yellow-bell pieces were rehearsed at the ritual court.

sentences.zh: 庚午，定選舉縣令法。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the law for selecting county magistrates was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, county magistrate selection rules were codified.

sentences.zh: 壬申，月犯填星。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the moon trespassed on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the moon crossed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 癸未，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積屍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengshen: Mars entered the Ghost lodge and trespassed on the piled corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengshen: Mars entered Ghost and struck the piled corpses.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，出內藏絹百萬市糴軍儲。

translations.literal: Day guihai: one million bolts of palace silk were released to buy grain for army stores.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, a million bolts of palace silk bought army grain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，深州大雨，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: Day renshen: great rain at Shen prefecture destroyed houses.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Shenzhou floods wrecked houses.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，閱雅樂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: elegant music was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dinghai: court music was reviewed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: morning feast at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, morning rites at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: feast at the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, offerings at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大饗天地於明堂，以太祖、太宗、真宗配，如圜丘。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: great feast to Heaven and Earth at the Bright Hall, with Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong as associates, as at the round altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Bright Hall hosted Heaven and Earth with Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong as associates, as at the round altar.

sentences.zh: 大赦，百官進秩一等。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; officials advanced one degree in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty followed; every official rose one rank.

sentences.zh: 詔自今內降指揮，百司執奏毋輒行。

translations.literal: Edict: from now on inner palace directives—departments were to memorialize and not execute at once.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth inner directives required memorial review before execution.

sentences.zh: 敢因緣幹請者，諫官、御史察舉之。

translations.literal: Those who used connections to seek favors—remonstrators and censors were to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: Pulling strings for favors would draw censor investigation.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，熒惑犯太微上將。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengwu: Mars trespassed on the Supreme General of Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengwu: Mars crossed the Supreme Palace’s chief general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宴京畿父老于錫慶院。

translations.literal: Day yihai: elders of the capital circuit were feasted at Xiqing Court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, capital elders were banqueted at Xiqing Court.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月己未，詔後妃之家毋得除二府職任。

translations.literal: Intercalary eleventh month, day jiwei, edict: families of empresses and consorts were not to receive posts in the two departments.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary eleventh month, jiwei: consort kin were barred from the two departments.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，秀州地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Xiuzhou quaked; the sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xiuzhou quaked like thunder.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔中書門下省、兩制及太常官詳定大樂。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, edict: the Secretariat-Chancellery, drafters, and ritual court were to fix great music in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, secretariat, drafters, and ritual court were to codify state music.

sentences.zh: 河北水，詔蠲民租，出內藏錢四十萬緡、絹四十萬匹付本路，使措置是歲芻糧。

translations.literal: Hebei flooded; rent was remitted; four hundred thousand strings and four hundred thousand bolts from the inner treasury were sent to the circuit for that year’s fodder.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei floods brought rent relief and four hundred thousand strings plus four hundred thousand bolts for fodder.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，定三品以上家廟制。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: the family-temple system for third rank and above was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiashen: family temples for third rank and above were regulated.

sentences.zh: 唃廝囉、西蕃瞎氈、西南蕃龍光㴰、占城、沙州來貢，涇原路生戶都首領那龍男阿日丁內附。

translations.literal: Gusiluo, Xizang’s Zhazhan, southwestern Fan Long Guang’ao, Champa, and Shazhou came to tribute; Jingyuan native household chief Nalongnan A’rading submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Gusiluo, Zhazhan, Long Guang’ao, Champa, and Shazhou; Jingyuan’s Nalongnan A’rading defected.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙丑，幸魏國大長公主第視疾。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day yichou: the Wei state grand princess’s residence was visited to see her illness.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, first month, yichou: he visited the sick Wei grand princess.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，宰臣文彥博等進《皇祐大饗明堂記》。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: Chief minister Wen Yanbo and others presented the Record of the Great Bright Hall Feast of Imperial Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingxu: Wen Yanbo submitted the Imperial Blessing Bright Hall record.

sentences.zh: 己亥，復行河北沿邊州軍入中糧草見錢法。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Hebei frontier cash-for-fodder delivery law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hebei’s cash-for-fodder law was restored.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，宋庠罷，以劉沆參知政事。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: Song Qiu was removed; Liu Kang became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengshen: Song Qiu fell; Liu Kang joined the council.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，儂智高表獻馴象及金銀，卻之。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Nong Zhigao memorialized presenting a tame elephant and gold and silver; they were declined.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Nong Zhigao’s elephant and gold were refused.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，詔：「河北流民相屬，吏不加恤，而乃飾廚傳，交賂使客，以取名譽。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiwei, edict: “Hebei refugees come in succession; clerks do not relieve them yet decorate kitchens and bribe envoys to win reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guiwei: the throne rebuked Hebei clerks who entertained envoys while ignoring refugees—

sentences.zh: 自今非犒設兵校，其一切禁之。

translations.literal: From now on, except feasting military officers, all such is forbidden.”
translations.idiomatic: only army feasts were allowed from now on.”

sentences.zh: 」丙申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，以恩、冀州旱，詔長吏決系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu: because of drought in En and Ji, local chiefs were to decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengxu: En and Ji drought sent chiefs to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 壬申，置河渠司。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the river-works office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the river-works office was founded.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，頒《簡要濟眾方》，命州縣長吏按方劑以救民疾。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Brief Formulas to Aid the Multitude was promulgated; prefectural and county chiefs were to dispense by prescription to save the people’s illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Brief Formulas to Aid the Multitude was issued for local officials to treat the sick.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，無為軍獻芝草，帝命姑免知軍茹孝標罪，戒州郡自今勿復獻。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: Wuwei army presented spirit fungus; the emperor ordered the military prefect Ru Xiaobiao’s crime temporarily remitted and warned prefectures not to present such again.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dinghai: Wuwei’s spirit fungus won Ru Xiaobiao a pardon and a ban on such gifts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，詔：「少卿、監以下，年七十不任厘務者，御史台、審官院以聞。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guichou, edict: “Assistant ministers and supervisors and below—those seventy who cannot manage affairs—the censorate and personnel court are to report.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guichou: officials seventy and unable to serve were to be reported by censors and personnel—

sentences.zh: 嘗任館閣、台諫及提刑者，中書裁處。

translations.literal: Those who once served the archives, remonstrance, or punishment intendancy—the Secretariat decides.
translations.idiomatic: former archive, remonstrance, or punishment staff fell to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 待制以上能自引年，則優加恩禮。

translations.literal: Awaiting appointment and above who can retire themselves receive added favor in ritual.”
translations.idiomatic: Awaiting appointment and above who retired voluntarily received extra honors.”

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，以孔氏子孫復知仙源縣事。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Confucius’s descendants again held Xianyuan county magistracy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Confucius’s heirs again held Xianyuan county.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，兩制、禮官上大樂，名曰《太安》。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: drafters and ritual officers presented great music titled Great Peace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, drafters presented great music called Great Peace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，河決大名府郭固口。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Yellow River burst at Guogu mouth, Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Yellow River broke at Daming’s Guogu mouth.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷、徙州縣長吏不任事者十有六人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: sixteen incompetent prefectural and county chiefs were removed or transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, sixteen failing local chiefs were removed or transferred.

sentences.zh: 丙子，減郴、永州、桂陽監丁身米歲十萬余石。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: head-tax rice at Chen, Yong, and Guiyang inspectorates was cut by over a hundred thousand shi yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Chen, Yong, and Guiyang head-tax rice was cut over a hundred thousand shi a year.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，遣使安撫京東、淮南、兩浙、荊湖、江南饑民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: envoys were sent to comfort famine victims of Jingdong, Huainan, two Zhes, Jinghu, and Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingxu: envoys comforted famine victims across the east and south.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔諸路監司具所部長吏治狀能否以聞。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict: circuit inspectors were to report their subordinates’ governance, competence or not.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, every circuit inspector was to rate local officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，汴河絕流。

translations.literal: That month: the Bian River dried up.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Bian River ran dry.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，文彥博罷，以龐籍同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士，高若訥為樞密使，梁適參知政事，王堯臣為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: Wen Yanbo was removed; Pang Ji became co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and Zhaowen grand academician; Gao Ruonu military affairs commissioner; Liang Shi participating administrator; Wang Yaochen vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengzi: Wen Yanbo fell; Pang Ji became co-chancellor; Gao Ruonu took military affairs; Liang Shi and Wang Yaochen joined the council.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，減漳州、泉州、興化軍丁米。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: head-tax rice of Zhang, Quan, and Xinghua army was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinhai: Zhang, Quan, and Xinghua head-tax rice was cut.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，新作渾儀。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengchen: a new armillary sphere was made.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengchen: a new armillary sphere was cast.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔文武官七十以上未致仕者，更不考課遷官。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: civil and military officials seventy and above not yet retired were no longer examined for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, officials seventy and still serving were exempted from promotion review.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷災傷州軍貢物。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: tribute from disaster-struck prefectures and armies was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, tribute from disaster counties was ended.

sentences.zh: 是歲，涇原樊家族密廝歌內附。

translations.literal: That year: the Fan Misige clan of Jingyuan submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jingyuan’s Fan Misige clan defected.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己巳，詔諸路貸民種。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day jisi, edict: all circuits were to lend seed to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Year four, first month, jisi: every circuit was to lend seed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，塞大名府決河。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Yellow River breach at Daming was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Daming’s river breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，蠲湖州民所貸官米。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi: official grain lent to Hu prefecture people was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengzi: Hu prefecture’s state grain loans were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou, edict: the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiyou: the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，蠲江南路民所貸種數十萬斛。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: several hundred thousand hu of seed lent to Jiangnan circuit people were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Jiangnan’s seed loans—hundreds of thousands of hu—were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔宮禁市物給實直，非所闕者毋市。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: palace purchases were to pay full value; what was not needed was not to be bought.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, palace buyers were to pay fair price and buy only what was needed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，詔修河兵夫逃亡死傷，會其數，以議官吏之罰。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen, edict: river laborers who fled, died, or were wounded—the numbers were to be totaled to decide officials’ penalties.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: river-worker deaths and desertions were to be tallied for official punishment.

sentences.zh: 廣源州蠻儂智高反。

translations.literal: The Guangyuan prefecture Fan Nong Zhigao rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan’s Nong Zhigao rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳朔，智高陷邕州，遂陷橫、貴等八州，圍廣州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi new moon: Zhigao took Yong prefecture, then Heng, Gui, and eight other prefectures, and besieged Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon yisi: Zhigao took Yongzhou, eight more prefectures, and besieged Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命知桂州陳曙率兵討智高。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Guizhou prefect Chen Shu was ordered to lead troops against Zhigao.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Guizhou’s Chen Shu marched against Zhigao.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，起前衛尉卿余靖為秘書監、湖南安撫使、知潭州，前尚書屯田員外郎、直史館楊畋體量安撫廣南、提舉經制盜賊事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: former chief of the palace guard Yu Jing was raised as director of the Secretariat, Hunan pacification commissioner, and prefect of Tan; former outer-office clerk of the farming colonies Yang Tian was made to survey and pacify Guangnan and oversee bandit affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai: Yu Jing was recalled to pacify Hunan; Yang Tian was sent to survey Guangnan banditry.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，改余靖為廣西安撫使、知桂州，命同提點廣東刑獄李樞與陳曙討智高，廣東轉運鈐轄司發兵援之。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Yu Jing was changed to Guangxi pacification commissioner and Guizhou prefect; Li Shu, co-intendant of Guangdong punishment, with Chen Shu against Zhigao; Guangdong transport controller issued troops to aid.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Yu Jing took Guangxi; Li Shu and Chen Shu attacked Zhigao with Guangdong reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以狄青為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Di Qing was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Di Qing became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，出內藏錢絹助河北軍儲。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi: palace silk was released to aid Hebei army stores.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yisi: palace silk fed Hebei army granaries.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命余靖經制廣南盜賊事。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Yu Jing was ordered to oversee Guangnan bandit military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yu Jing took overall Guangnan bandit command.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大風拔木。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，智高引眾去廣州，廣東兵馬鈐轄張忠、知英州蘇緘邀擊于白田，忠戰歿。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zhigao led his host away from Guang prefecture; Guangdong horse inspector Zhang Zhong and Ying prefecture prefect Su Jian intercepted at Baitian; Zhong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zhigao left Guangzhou; Zhang Zhong and Su Jian ambushed him at Baitian—Zhong fell.

sentences.zh: 甲子，廣東兵馬鈐轄蔣偕又敗于路田。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Guangdong horse inspector Jiang Jie was again defeated at Lutian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Jiang Jie was beaten again at Lutian.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，詔開封府比大風雨，民廬摧圮壓死者，官為祭斂之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiwei, edict: compared with great wind and rain in the capital—where houses collapsed and people were crushed—the state was to bury and mourn them.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guiwei: capital storm victims crushed in collapsed houses were to be buried at state expense.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命樞密直學士孫沔安撫湖南、江西，內侍押班石全斌副之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Military Affairs academician Sun Hao was ordered to pacify Hunan and Jiangxi; eunuch duty officer Shi Quanbin was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Sun Hao pacified Hunan and Jiangxi with eunuch Shi Quanbin as deputy.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，命余靖提舉廣南兵甲經制賊盜事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi: Yu Jing was ordered to oversee Guangnan arms and bandit affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingsi: Yu Jing took Guangnan arms and bandit oversight.

sentences.zh: 庚申，廣西兵馬鈐轄王正倫討智高於昭州館門驛，戰歿。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Guangxi horse inspector Wang Zhenlun attacked Zhigao at Zhaozhou Guanmen post and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Zhenlun died attacking Zhigao at Zhaozhou’s Guanmen post.

sentences.zh: 智高入昭州。

translations.literal: Zhigao entered Zhao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhigao entered Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以狄青為宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Di Qing was made commissioner of the southern bureau of the military affairs court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Di Qing took the southern military affairs bureau.

sentences.zh: 宣撫荊湖路、提舉廣南經制賊盜事。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner of Jinghu circuit; overseer of Guangnan bandit military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified Jinghu and oversaw Guangnan bandit forces.

sentences.zh: 是月，智高襲殺蔣偕于太平場。

translations.literal: That month: Zhigao ambushed and killed Jiang Jie at Taiping field.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhigao killed Jiang Jie in ambush at Taiping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingzi: Venus trespassed on the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingzi: Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 詔鄜延、環慶、涇原路擇蕃落廣銳軍各五千人赴廣南行營。

translations.literal: Edict: Bin-Yan, Huan-Qing, and Jingyuan circuits were to choose five thousand Guangrui Fan troops each for the Guangnan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand Guangrui Fan each from Bin-Yan, Huan-Qing, and Jingyuan were drafted for Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，智高入賓州。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Zhigao entered Bin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Zhigao entered Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，復入邕州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: he again entered Yong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, he re-entered Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以諸路饑疫並征徭科調之煩，令轉運使、提點刑獄、親民官條陳救恤之術以聞。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because of famine, plague, and the burden of levies and corvée on all circuits, transport commissioners, punishment intendants, and local chiefs were to list relief methods and report.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, famine, plague, and levies on every circuit required relief plans from transport and local chiefs.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon renyin: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔免江西、湖南、廣南民供軍須者今年秋租十之三。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon renyin: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申朔，廣西兵馬鈐轄陳曙討智高兵，戰于金城驛。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: remit one-third of this year’s autumn tax for people of Jiangxi, Hunan, and Guangnan who supplied military needs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Guangnan suppliers of the armies lost a third of autumn tax.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，觀新樂。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen new moon: Guangxi military inspector Chen Shu’s troops fought Nong Zhigao’s army at Jincheng post station.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon renshen: Chen Shu clashed with Zhigao at Jincheng post.

sentences.zh: 乙未，錄唐顏真卿後。

translations.literal: Day renchen: new music was viewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the court heard the new ritual music.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河北路及鄜州水，蠲河北民積年逋負、鄜州民稅役。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: descendants of Tang’s Yan Zhenqing were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, heirs of Tang’s Yan Zhenqing were recorded.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬寅朔，御大慶殿受朝。

translations.literal: That year: Hebei circuit and Zhen prefecture suffered floods; Hebei people’s long-overdue levies and Zhen people’s tax and corvée were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods hit Hebei and Zhenzhou; old Hebei arrears and Zhen tax and corvée were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以廣南用兵，罷上元張燈。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day renyin new moon: the emperor received court at Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Year five, first month, new moon renyin: New Year homage at Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: because of the Guangnan campaign, Shangyuan lantern displays were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the southern war darkened the Shangyuan lamps.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，會靈觀火。

translations.literal: A white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow ran through the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊午，狄青敗智高於邕州，斬首五千余級，智高遁去。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Huiling Guan burned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Huiling Guan burned.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣使撫問廣南將校，賜軍士緡錢。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Di Qing defeated Nong Zhigao at Yong prefecture, beheaded more than five thousand; Zhigao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Di Qing shattered Zhigao at Yongzhou—five thousand heads—and Zhigao escaped.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，狄青復為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: envoys were sent to comfort Guangnan officers; soldiers were granted cash.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, envoys comforted Guangnan’s officers and the troops received cash.

sentences.zh: 甲申，赦廣南。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiwei: Di Qing was again made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guiwei: Di Qing returned to the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 凡戰沒者，給槥櫝護送還家，無主者葬祭之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: amnesty for Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Guangnan was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 賊所過郡縣，免其田租一年，死事家科徭二年。

translations.literal: For all killed in battle, coffins were provided and escorted home; where there were no kin, burial and mourning were performed.
translations.idiomatic: The fallen were coffined and sent home; the kinless were buried and mourned at state expense.

sentences.zh: 貢舉人免解至禮部，不預奏名者亦以名聞。

translations.literal: In counties and prefectures the bandits had passed through, land tax was remitted one year; families of the dead were exempt from corvée two years.
translations.idiomatic: Ravaged counties lost a year of land tax; bereaved families two years of corvée.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔廣西都監蕭注等追捕智高。

translations.literal: Examination candidates were exempted from preliminary qualification to the Ministry of Rites; those not on the preliminary named list were also reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates skipped the prefectural gate to the Ministry of Rites—even men not on the preliminary roll were named.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，下德音：減江西、湖南系囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: Guangxi commander Xiao Zhu and others were to pursue Zhigao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Xiao Zhu and other Guangxi commanders were ordered after Zhigao.

sentences.zh: 丁壯饋運廣南軍須者，減夏稅之半，仍免差徭一年。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, lenient edict: reduce crimes of Jiangxi and Hunan prisoners one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Jiangxi and Hunan won one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔百官遇南郊奏薦，無子孫者聽奏期親一人。

translations.literal: Able-bodied men supplying Guangnan military needs had summer tax halved and corvée exempted one year.
translations.idiomatic: Men hauling Guangnan supplies saw summer tax halved and a year without corvée.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔宗室通經者，大宗正司以聞。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: at southern-suburb nominations, those without sons might nominate one patrilateral kin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, childless officials at the southern suburb could name one patrilateral kin instead.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，遣使奉安太祖御容于滁州，太宗御容於并州，真宗御容於澶州。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: imperial clansmen versed in the classics were to be reported by the Great Lineage Office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, classical clansmen were to be reported by the lineage office.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身千四十二人。

translations.literal: Third month, day guihai: envoys were sent to install Taizu’s portrait at Chuzhou, Taizong’s at Bingzhou, and Zhenzong’s at Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guihai: Taizu’s image went to Chuzhou, Taizong’s to Bingzhou, Zhenzong’s to Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，命劉沆、梁適監議大樂。

translations.literal: That month: one thousand forty-two jinshi and degree-holders of various examinations were conferred.
translations.idiomatic: That month, 1,042 jinshi and degree-holders graduated.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，詔輔臣凡有大政，許復對後殿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: Liu Yong and Liang Shi were ordered to supervise deliberation on court music.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiawu: Liu Yong and Liang Shi oversaw the great-music review.

sentences.zh: 高若訥罷，以狄青為樞密使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi, edict: chief ministers, whenever there was major policy, might follow up with audience at the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi: on great matters the cabinet could seek a second audience in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 丁未，孫沔為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Gao Ruonuo was removed; Di Qing was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ruonuo fell; Di Qing took the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔轉運使毋取羨餘以助三司。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Sun Hao was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Sun Hao joined the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔智高所至州，無城壘，若兵力不敵而棄城者，奏裁。

translations.literal: Day wushen, edict: transport commissioners were not to take surpluses to aid the Finance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, circuit surpluses could no longer be skimmed for the Finance Commission.

sentences.zh: 壬子，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: in prefectures Zhigao reached that had no walls, if troops were insufficient and the city was abandoned, report for decision.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, unwalled towns overrun by Zhigao—if abandoned for lack of force—were to be reported for judgment.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔轉運司振邕州貧民，戶貸米一石。

translations.literal: Day renyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔諫官、御史毋挾私以中善良，及臣僚言機密事毋得漏泄。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: the transport office was to relieve Yong’s poor—one picul of rice loaned per household.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yong’s poor each borrowed a picul of rice from the transport office.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，御紫宸殿，按《太安樂》，觀宗廟祭器。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: remonstrance officials and censors were not to use private grudges against good men; nor might officials speaking of state secrets leak them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, censors were forbidden private vendettas; and no one who heard state secrets might leak them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，作集禧觀成。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: at Zichen Hall the Taian music was performed and ancestral temple vessels were viewed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai: at Zichen Hall the court played Taian and inspected temple vessels.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔河北薦饑，轉運使察州縣長吏能招輯勞來者，上其狀；

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Jixi Guan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Jixi Guan was finished.

sentences.zh: 不稱職者舉劾之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: with Hebei stricken by famine, transport commissioners were to inspect prefectural and county chiefs who could gather and comfort the people and report their merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, famine-stricken Hebei was to reward magistrates who gathered and comforted the people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，詔荊湖北路民因災傷所貸常平倉米免償。

translations.literal: Those unfit for office were to be impeached.
translations.idiomatic: The unfit were to be impeached.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔薦舉非其人者，令御史台彈奏，見任監司以上弗許薦論。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi, edict: Hubei people’s Ever-Normal granary loans from disaster were exempted from repayment.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yisi: Hubei disaster loans from the Ever-Normal granary were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔太常定諡，毋為溢美。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: where recommendations were unworthy, the Censorate was to impeach; current commissioners and above might not recommend or discuss candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, bad nominees drew censorial impeachment—and sitting commissioners could no longer sponsor men.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊辰，詔廣南民逃未還者，限一年歸業，其復三歲。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: the Court of Sacrifices was to fix posthumous titles without excessive praise.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, posthumous titles were to be honest, not flattering.

sentences.zh: 壬申，龐籍罷，以陳執中同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士，梁適同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day wuchen, edict: Guangnan people who had fled and not returned had one year to resume livelihood; they were exempt three years.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wuchen: Guangnan refugees had a year to return—and three years’ relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔武臣知州軍，須與僚屬參議公事，毋專決。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Pang Ji was removed; Chen Zhongzhong was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Liang Shi was made co-director and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Pang Ji fell; Chen Zhongzhong became Zhaowen co-chancellor; Liang Shi became Jixian co-chancellor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，秦鳳路言總管劉煥等破蕃部，斬首二千餘級。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: military prefects and army commanders must deliberate with staff on public business and not decide alone.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, military prefects had to consult their staffs—no solo decrees.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，詔民訴災傷而監司不受者，聽州軍以狀聞。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Qin Feng circuit reported overall commander Liu Huan and others had broken fan tribes, beheading more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Qin Feng reported Liu Huan’s two thousand fan heads.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，策制舉、武舉人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingyou new moon, edict: if people reported disaster injury and commissioners would not receive the petition, prefectures and armies might report by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon dingyou: ignored disaster petitions could go straight from the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔南郊以太祖、太宗、真宗並配。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: special examination and military examination candidates were tested.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, special civil and military examinations were held.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，觀新樂。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: at the southern suburb Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong were all to be apportioned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the southern suburb paired all three founding emperors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou: new music was viewed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yiyou: the court heard new music.

sentences.zh: 壬子，作「鎮國神寶」。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, new moon bingshen: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔以蝗旱，令監司諭親民官上民間利害。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the “Pacifying State Divine Treasure” seal was made.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Pacifying State Divine Treasure seal was cast.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: because of locusts and drought, commissioners were to instruct local officials to report popular harm and benefit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, locust and drought commissioners were told to bring up local grievances and remedies.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，饗太廟、奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: morning feast at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingmao: morning rites at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: feast at the imperial temple and Offering Grace temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, offerings at the ancestral and Offering Grace temples.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, suburban rites brought a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊子，放天下逋負。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: favors were extended to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the bureaucracy was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，詔轉運官毋得進羨餘。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: arrears throughout the realm were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, empire-wide debts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以曹、陳、許、鄭、滑州為輔郡，隸畿內，置京畿轉運使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu, edict: transport officials were not to present surpluses.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuwu: circuit surpluses could no longer be offered up.

sentences.zh: 是歲，占城國來貢。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Cao, Chen, Xu, Zheng, and Hua prefectures were made auxiliary prefectures under the capital region; a metropolitan transport commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, five prefectures joined the inner circuit and a metropolitan transport commissioner was named.

sentences.zh: 至和元年春正月辛未，詔京師大寒，民多凍餒死者，有司其瘞埋之。

translations.literal: That year: Champa came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，碎通天犀，和藥以療民疫。

translations.literal: Zhihe year one, spring, first month, day xinwei, edict: in the capital the cold was severe and many people died of freezing and hunger; the authorities were to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihe 1, first month, xinwei: the capital’s freeze victims were to be buried at state expense.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，貴妃張氏薨，輟視朝七日，禁京城樂一月。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the heaven-piercing rhinoceros horn was ground and mixed into medicine to treat the people’s plague.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the heaven-piercing rhinoceros was pulverized for plague medicine.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，追冊為皇后，賜諡溫成。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Honored Consort Zhang died; court audiences were suspended seven days and capital music forbidden one month.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Honored Consort Zhang died—seven days without court, a month without capital music.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，錄系囚，減三京、輔郡雜犯死罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: she was posthumously enfeoffed as empress and given the posthumous title Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, she became Empress Wencheng posthumously.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，詔治河堤民有疫死者，蠲戶稅一年；

translations.literal: Day xinmao: prisoners were reviewed; capital crimes in the three capitals and auxiliary prefectures were reduced one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, prisoners were reviewed—the three capitals and inner circuit won one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 無戶稅者，給其家錢三千。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi, edict: for river-dike laborers who died of plague, household tax was remitted one year.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengzi: dike workers who died of plague cost their households a year of tax.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，孫沔罷，以田況為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Where there was no household tax, three thousand cash was given to the family.
translations.idiomatic: Taxless families received three thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，王貽永罷，以王德用為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Sun Hao was removed; Tian Kuang was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Sun Hao fell; Tian Kuang joined the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命曾公亮等同試入內醫官。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi: Wang Yiyong was removed; Wang Deyong was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jisi: Wang Yiyong fell; Wang Deyong took the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜邊臣攻守圖。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Zeng Gongliang and others were ordered jointly to test incoming palace physicians.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zeng Gongliang and others examined palace physicians.

sentences.zh: 置京畿提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Day renshen: frontier ministers were given attack-and-defense maps.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, border commanders received attack-and-defense maps.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太史言日當食四月朔。

translations.literal: The metropolitan judicial intendant was established.
translations.idiomatic: A metropolitan judicial intendant was appointed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，下德音：改元，減死罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Astronomical Bureau said the sun would be eclipsed on the fourth-month new moon.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, astronomers predicted an eclipse at the fourth-month new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸未，易服，避正殿，減常膳。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, lenient edict: the era name was changed; capital crimes were reduced one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, a new reign title came with one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔京西民饑，宜令所在勸富人納粟以振之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: dress was changed; the main hall was avoided; regular meals were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the court changed dress, left the main hall, and cut the table.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午朔，日有食之，用牲於社。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, edict: with famine in western Jing, the locality was to urge the wealthy to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, western Jing was told to press rich men to sell grain for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，御正殿，復常膳。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu new moon: there was a solar eclipse; victims were offered at the soil altar.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon jiawu: the sun was eclipsed and victims were offered to the soil god.

sentences.zh: 祥源觀火。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the emperor returned to the main hall and restored regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the court returned to the main hall and full meals.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，以河北流民稍復，遣使安撫。

translations.literal: Xiangyuan Guan burned.
translations.idiomatic: Fire took Xiangyuan Guan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: because Hebei refugees were gradually returning, envoys were sent to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuyin: as Hebei refugees returned, envoys went to comfort them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，以程戡參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 立溫成園。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingmao: Cheng Zhan was made participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingmao: Cheng Zhan joined the council.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，梁適罷。

translations.literal: Wencheng Garden was established.
translations.idiomatic: Wencheng Garden was founded.

sentences.zh: 己巳，出御史馬遵、呂景初、吳中復。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Liang Shi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Liang Shi fell.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔：「前代帝王後嘗仕本朝，官八品以下，其祖父母、父母、妻子犯流以下罪，聽贖；

translations.literal: Censors Ma Zun, Lü Jingchu, and Wu Zhongfu were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zun, Lü Jingchu, and Wu Zhongfu left the censorate.

sentences.zh: 未仕而嘗受朝廷賜者，所犯非兇惡，亦聽贖。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingyou, edict: “For descendants of former dynasties’ emperors who once served this court at rank eight or below, if grandparents, parents, wives, or children committed crimes below exile, redemption was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingyou: eighth-rank descendants of former emperors who served the Song could redeem kin below exile.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，以劉沆同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Those who had not served but had received court gifts, if the crime was not vicious, might also redeem.”
translations.idiomatic: Unserved heirs who had received imperial gifts could redeem non-violent crimes as well.

sentences.zh: 命修起居注官侍經筵。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liu Yong was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Liu Yong became Jixian co-chancellor.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，契丹遣使來告夏國平。

translations.literal: Diarists of record were ordered to attend the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: Diarists were ordered to the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣三司使王拱辰報使契丹。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yihai: Khitan sent envoys reporting peace with Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yihai: Khitan reported peace with Xia.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Finance Commissioner Wang Gongchen was sent as envoy to report to Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Wang Gongchen went to Khitan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔士庶家毋得以嘗傭顧之人為姻，違者離之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinmao new moon: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, new moon xinmao: Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，葬溫成皇后。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: commoners’ households might not take as marriage kin persons once hired as servants; violators were to be separated.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, gentry could not marry former servants—violators were divorced.

sentences.zh: 丙午，溫成皇后神主入廟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Empress Wencheng was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Empress Wencheng was buried.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸城北炮場觀發炮，宴從臣，賜衛士緡錢。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Empress Wencheng’s spirit tablet entered the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Empress Wencheng’s tablet entered the temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，出太廟禘袷、時饗及溫成皇后廟祭饗樂章，肄于太常。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the emperor visited the northern city cannon range to watch firing, feasted followers, and granted guards cash.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, he watched cannon fire north of the city, feasted his followers, and paid the guards.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，詔司天監天文算術官毋得出入臣僚家。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: music for the imperial temple’s diye and seasonal offerings and for Empress Wencheng’s temple was issued and rehearsed at the Court of Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiazi: new temple and Wencheng rites were issued and rehearsed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔內侍傳宣，令都知司劄報，被旨者覆奏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu, edict: astronomical and calendrical officers of the Directorate of Astronomy might not enter officials’ homes.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingwu: court astronomers were barred from officials’ houses.

sentences.zh: 是歲，融州大丘洞楊光朝內附。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: when eunuchs conveyed oral orders, the Directorate of Service was to record them on plaques; recipients were to memorialize in reply.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, eunuch orders had to be plaque-recorded and answered by memorial.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁卯，奉安真宗御容于萬壽觀。

translations.literal: That year: Yang Guangchao of Rong prefecture’s Daqiu cave submitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yang Guangchao of Daqiu cave submitted.

sentences.zh: 減畿內、輔郡囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day dingmao: Zhenzong’s portrait was installed at Wanshou Guan.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, dingmao: Zhenzong’s image entered Wanshou Guan.

sentences.zh: 賜諸軍緡錢。

translations.literal: Crimes of prisoners in the capital region and auxiliary prefectures were reduced one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: The inner circuit won one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，邕州言蘇茂州蠻內寇，詔廣西發兵討之。

translations.literal: The armies were granted cash.
translations.idiomatic: The armies received cash.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，晏殊薨。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Yong prefecture reported Sumao prefecture barbarians raiding inward; Guangxi was ordered to send troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yongzhou reported Sumao raids; Guangxi troops were ordered out.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，汾州團練推官郭固上車戰法，既試之，授衛尉丞。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Yan Shu died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Yan Shu died.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，詔修起居注立於講讀官之次。

translations.literal: Second month, day renchen: Guo Gu of Fenzhou training-and-push officer submitted chariot warfare methods; after trial he was made vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renchen: Guo Gu of Fenzhou tested chariot tactics and became a vice director of imperial sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封孔子後為衍聖公。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingmao, edict: the diarist of record was to stand after the lecture officials.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingmao: the diarist took rank after the lecture masters.

sentences.zh: 是月，以旱，除畿內民逋芻及去年秋逋稅，罷營繕諸役。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Confucius’ descendant was enfeoffed Duke of Yan Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Confucius’ heir became Duke of Yan Sheng.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，契丹遣使賀乾元節，以其主之命持本國三世畫像來求御容。

translations.literal: That month: because of drought, fodder arrears and last autumn’s tax arrears in the capital region were remitted and construction corvée was halted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, drought canceled inner-circuit fodder and tax arrears and stopped construction.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，定差衙前法。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: Khitan sent envoys congratulating the Qianyuan festival, bearing portraits of three generations of their state and seeking an imperial portrait.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jihai: Khitan came for Qianyuan with three dynastic portraits and asked for the emperor’s image.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，出米京城門，下其價以濟流民。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the corvée-yamen-runner assignment law was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, yamen-runner assignment was codified.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，錄系囚、。

translations.literal: Day yimao: grain was released at the capital gates and the price lowered to aid refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, capital grain was sold cheap at the gates for refugees.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔中書公事並用祖宗故事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiwei: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔戒百官務飭官守。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: Secretariat business was altogether to follow ancestral precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Secretariat was bound to ancestral precedent.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，陳執中罷。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: admonish the hundred officials to keep their offices in order.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, officials were warned to mind their duties.

sentences.zh: 以文彥博同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士，劉沆監修國史，富弼同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuxu: Chen Zhongzhong was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuxu: Chen Zhongzhong fell.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，儂智高母儂氏、弟智光、子繼宗、繼封伏誅。

translations.literal: Wen Yanbo was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Liu Yong supervised compilation of the national history; Fu Bi was made co-director and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo became Zhaowen co-chancellor; Liu Yong oversaw the national history; Fu Bi became Jixian co-chancellor.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊子，減畿內、輔郡囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Nong Zhigao’s mother the Nong clan, brother Zhiguang, and sons Jizong and Jifeng were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhigao’s mother, brother, and sons were executed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，置台諫章奏簿。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day wuzi: crimes of prisoners in the capital region and auxiliary prefectures were reduced one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuzi: the inner circuit again won one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔中書、樞密院第宗姓服屬，自明堂覃恩後及十年者，鹹與進官。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the remonstrance memorial register was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the remonstrance memorial register was opened.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，契丹使來告其國主宗真殂，帝為發哀，成服於內東門幕次，遣使祭奠、吊慰及賀其子洪基立。

translations.literal: Day renzi, edict: the Secretariat and Military Commission were to rank imperial-clan kinship; those ten years after the Mingtang grace enfeoffment all received promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, clansmen a decade past the Mingtang grace were all promoted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔試醫官須引《醫經》、《本草》以對，每試十道，以六通為合格。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: Khitan envoys reported their ruler Zongzhen had died; the emperor mourned, wore hemp in the inner east gate tent, and sent envoys to condole, comfort, and congratulate his son Hongji’s accession.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: Khitan mourned Zongzhen—the emperor wore hemp at the inner east gate and sent envoys to Hongji.

sentences.zh: 辛己，罷輔臣、宣徽、節度使乾元節任子恩。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: medical officers tested must cite the Medical Canon and Materia Medica—ten questions, six correct to pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, physician exams required six of ten answers from the classics and materia medica.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，錄唐長孫無忌後。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Qianyuan festival privilege of appointing sons for chief ministers, palace commissioners, and military governors was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Qianyuan son appointments for the great were ended.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔京畿毋領輔郡，罷京畿轉運使、提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingxu: descendants of Tang’s Zhangsun Wuji were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingxu: heirs of Tang’s Zhangsun Wuji were recorded.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，下溪州蠻彭仕羲內寇，詔湖北路發兵捕之。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: the capital region was not to administer auxiliary prefectures; the metropolitan transport commissioner and judicial intendant were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, auxiliary prefectures left the inner circuit and its transport and judicial posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，交阯來告李德政卒，其子日尊上德政遺留物及馴象。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Xixia barbarian Peng Shiyi of Xiaxi prefecture raided inward; Hubei was ordered to send troops to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Peng Shiyi of Xiaxi raided; Hubei troops were ordered after him.

sentences.zh: 己未，行並邊見錢和糴法。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yimao: Jiaozhi reported Li Dezheng’s death; his son Rizun sent Dezheng’s bequests and tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yimao: Jiaozhi mourned Li Dezheng—his son sent bequests and elephants.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，修六塔河。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the along-border cash grain-purchase law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, border cash grain purchase took effect.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔武臣有贓濫者毋得轉橫行，其立戰功者許之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai: the Liuta River was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dinghai: the Liuta River was repaired.

sentences.zh: 庚子，契丹遣使致其主宗真遺留物及謝弔祭。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: military officers guilty of corruption might not transfer to lateral commands; those with battle merit were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, corrupt officers could not lateral-transfer—unless they had battle merit.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Khitan sent envoys presenting their late ruler Zongzhen’s bequests and thanking for condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Khitan brought Zongzhen’s bequests and thanks for mourning.

sentences.zh: 壬子，作醴泉觀成。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西界阿訛等內附，詔遣還。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Liquan Guan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Liquan Guan was finished.

sentences.zh: 龍賜州彭師黨以其族來歸，大食國、西蕃、安化州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year: western frontier A’e and others submitted and were ordered returned; Peng Shidang of Longci prefecture came with his clan; Dashi, western fan, and Anhua barbarians sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year western submitters were sent home; Peng Shidang’s clan came in; Dashi, western Tibetans, and Anhua tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐元年春正月甲寅朔，御大慶殿受朝。

translations.literal: Jiayou year one, spring, first month, day jiayin new moon: the emperor received court at Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 1, first month, new moon jiayin: New Year homage at Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 是日，不豫。

translations.literal: That day he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，輔臣禱祠於大慶殿，齋宿殿廡。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: chief ministers prayed at Daqing Hall and fasted in the hall wings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the cabinet prayed at Daqing Hall and fasted in its wings.

sentences.zh: 近臣禱於寺觀，及遣諸州長吏禱于岳瀆諸祠。

translations.literal: Close officials prayed at temples; prefectural chiefs were sent to pray at mountain and river shrines.
translations.idiomatic: Intimates prayed in temples; prefects prayed at rivers and mountains.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御崇政殿。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the emperor held court at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, he held court at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜在京諸軍緡錢。

translations.literal: Day guihai: capital armies were granted cash.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the capital armies were paid.

sentences.zh: 甲子，赦天下，蠲被災田租及倚閣稅。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: amnesty throughout the realm; disaster-struck land tax and suspended levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the empire was amnestied and disaster taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷上元張燈。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Shangyuan lantern displays were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Shangyuan lamps were darkened.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命輔臣禱天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: chief ministers were ordered to pray to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the cabinet prayed to Heaven, Earth, ancestors, and the altars.

sentences.zh: 是月，大雨雪，木冰。

translations.literal: That month: heavy rain and snow; trees were coated with ice.
translations.idiomatic: That month brought heavy snow and glaze ice on the trees.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，帝疾愈，御延和殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: the emperor’s illness abated; he held court at Yanhe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiachen: recovered, he held court at Yanhe Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi, edict: the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingsi: the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 辛未，司天監言：自至和元年五月，客星晨出東方守天關，至是沒。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the Astronomical Bureau said that from Zhihe year one, fifth month, a guest star had stood in the east guarding Tian Guan until now it set.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, astronomers said a guest star had guarded Tian Guan in the east since Zhihe 1, fifth month, and now vanished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣官謝天地、宗廟、社稷、寺觀、諸祠。

translations.literal: Day renshen: officials were sent to thank Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, the altars of soil and grain, temples, and shrines.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, thanks were offered at Heaven, Earth, temples, altars, and shrines.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，契丹遣使來謝。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Khitan sent envoys to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Khitan envoys gave thanks.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未朔，以王堯臣參知政事，程戡為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guimao new moon: Wang Yaochan was made participating administrator; Cheng Zhan was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, new moon guimao: Wang Yaochan joined the council; Cheng Zhan the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 詔前後殿間日視事。

translations.literal: Edict: the front and rear halls were to hold audiences on alternate days.
translations.idiomatic: The front and rear halls would hear business on alternate days.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子朔，六塔河復決。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi new moon: the Liuta River burst again.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon renzi: the Liuta River broke again.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，裁定補蔭選舉法。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the supplementary-enfeoffment and examination law was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, enfeoffment and examination rules were codified.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 是月，大雨，水注安上門，門關折，壞官私廬舍數萬區。

translations.literal: That month: heavy rain; water poured at Anshang Gate, the gate bolt broke, and tens of thousands of public and private buildings were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: That month, rain smashed Anshang Gate and wrecked tens of thousands of buildings.

sentences.zh: 諸路言江、河決溢，河北尤甚。

translations.literal: Circuits reported rivers overflowing; Hebei suffered most.
translations.idiomatic: Circuits reported floods—Hebei worst of all.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥朔，詔雙日不御殿，伏終如舊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinhai new moon, edict: on double days the emperor would not hold court; the summer recess was as before.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon xinhai: double days without court; summer recess unchanged.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免畿內、京東西、河北被水民賦租。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: tax and rent were remitted for people of the capital region, eastern and western Jing, and Hebei stricken by water.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, flood-stricken inner circuit, Jing, and Hebei taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雨壞太社、太稷壇。

translations.literal: Day yihai: rain destroyed the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, rain wrecked the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣使安撫河北。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: envoys were sent to comfort Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, envoys comforted Hebei.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔群臣實封言時政闕失。

translations.literal: Day jimao, edict: ministers were to seal memorials stating current policy failures in truth.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, ministers were told to seal honest critiques of policy failures.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，命京東西、湖北監司分行水災州軍振饑蠲租。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiyou: eastern and western Jing and Hubei commissioners were ordered to tour flood-stricken prefectures and armies to relieve famine and remit rent.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yiyou: Jing and Hubei commissioners toured floods to feed the hungry and cut rent.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜河北流民米，壓溺死者，賜其家錢有差。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: grain was granted to Hebei refugees; for those drowned, cash was given to families in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hebei refugees got grain—and drowned families graded cash.

sentences.zh: 己丑，出內藏銀絹三十萬振貸河北。

translations.literal: Day jichou: three hundred thousand strings of silver and silk from the inner treasury were lent for Hebei relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, three hundred thousand strings from the inner treasury went to Hebei relief.

sentences.zh: 月入南斗。

translations.literal: The moon entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: The moon crossed into the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，貸被水災民麥種。

translations.literal: Day yisi: wheat seed was loaned to flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, flood victims borrowed wheat seed.

sentences.zh: 是月，彗出紫微垣，長丈餘。

translations.literal: That month: a comet appeared in the Purple Forbidden enclosure, more than a zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: That month a comet a zhang long hung in the Purple Forbidden enclosure.

sentences.zh: 環州小遇族叛，知州張揆破降之。

translations.literal: Huan prefecture’s Xiaoyu tribe rebelled; prefect Zhang Hui defeated and accepted their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Huanzhou’s Xiaoyu tribe rebelled; Zhang Hui broke them and took their surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon gengxu: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，狄青罷，以韓琦為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Di Qing was removed; Han Qi was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Di Qing fell; Han Qi took the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 是夕彗滅。

translations.literal: That evening the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: That night the comet died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，出恭謝樂章，肄于太常。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Thank-offering music was issued and rehearsed at the Court of Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, thank-offering music was issued and rehearsed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，朝謁景靈宮，減京城系囚徒罪一等，杖笞釋之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: audience at Jingling Palace; capital prisoners below exile had crimes reduced one degree; beating and flogging released.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jingling audience—capital prisoners below exile won one grade; beatings were released.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔湖北招安彭仕羲。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: Hubei was to win over Peng Shiyi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Hubei was ordered to win Peng Shiyi.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，命宰臣攝事於太廟。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: chief ministers were ordered to act at the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: the cabinet officiated at the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，恭謝天地於大慶殿，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Heaven and Earth were thanked at Daqing Hall; great amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, thanks at Daqing Hall brought amnesty and a new reign title.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: favors were extended to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the bureaucracy was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜致仕卿、監以上及曾任近侍之臣粟帛酒饌。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: grain, silk, wine, and food were granted to retired officials of courtier-and-above rank and former close attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, retired courtiers and former intimates received grain, silk, wine, and food.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，舉行御史遷次格。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the censorial promotion roster was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the censorial promotion roster took effect.

sentences.zh: 自京至泗州置汴河木岸。

translations.literal: Timber revetments were set along the Bian River from the capital to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Timber revetments lined the Bian River from the capital to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，王德用罷，賈昌朝為樞密使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi: Wang Deyong was removed; Jia Changchao was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinsi: Wang Deyong fell; Jia Changchao took the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，劉沆罷，以曾公亮參知政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: Liu Yong was removed; Zeng Gongliang was made participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renzi: Liu Yong fell; Zeng Gongliang joined the council.

sentences.zh: 甲子，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, a white rainbow ran through the sun.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西蕃磨氈角、占城、大食國來貢。

translations.literal: That year: western Tibetan Mozhanjiao, Champa, and Dashi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Mozhanjiao, Champa, and Dashi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 融、桂州蠻楊克端等內附。

translations.literal: Rong and Gui prefecture barbarians Yang Keduan and others submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Keduan and other Rong and Gui tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月己酉，梓夔路三里村夷人寇淯井監。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, second month, day jiyou: Zili and Kui circuit Sanli village barbarians raided Youjing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, second month, jiyou: Sanli village tribes raided Youjing in Zili and Kui.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，錄系囚，降罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: prisoners were reviewed; crimes were reduced one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, prisoners were reviewed—one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 遣使錄三京、輔郡系囚。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to review prisoners of the three capitals and auxiliary prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys reviewed the three capitals’ and inner circuit’s jails.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，杜衍薨。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Du Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Du Yan died.

sentences.zh: 澧州羅城洞蠻內寇，發兵擊走之。

translations.literal: Li prefecture’s Luocheng cave barbarians raided inward; troops were sent and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Li prefecture’s Luocheng cave tribes raided and were driven off.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王德用卒。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Wang Deyong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Deyong died.

sentences.zh: 是月，雄、霸州地震。

translations.literal: That month: Xiong and Ba prefectures suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiongzhou and Bazhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，振河北被災民。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin: Hebei flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuyin: Hebei flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，契丹使耶律防、陳覬來求御容。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Khitan envoys Yelü Fang and Chen Ji came seeking an imperial portrait.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yelü Fang and Chen Ji of Khitan came for the emperor’s portrait.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，淮水溢。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the Huai River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Huai overflowed.

sentences.zh: 遣張昪報使契丹。

translations.literal: Zhang Bian was sent as envoy to report to Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bian went to Khitan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，狄青卒。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Di Qing died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Di Qing died.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身八百七十七人。

translations.literal: That month: eight hundred seventy-seven jinshi and degree-holders of various examinations were conferred.
translations.idiomatic: That month, 877 jinshi and degree-holders graduated.

sentences.zh: 親試舉人免黜落始此。

translations.literal: The emperor personally testing candidates without failing any began here.
translations.idiomatic: Here began the palace examination with no failures.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，以河北地數震，遣使安撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingwei: because Hebei had repeated earthquakes, envoys were sent to comfort and soothe.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingwei: repeated Hebei earthquakes brought comfort envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幽州地大震，壞城郭，覆壓死者數萬人。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Youzhou suffered a great earthquake; city walls were ruined; tens of thousands died buried under collapse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, a great Youzhou quake shattered the city and killed tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 己巳，邕州火峒蠻儂宗旦入寇。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Yong prefecture Fire Cave barbarian Nong Zongdan invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Nong Zongdan of Yong’s Fire Cave tribes raided the border.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以彭仕羲未降，遣官安撫湖北。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: because Peng Shixi had not surrendered, officials were sent to comfort and soothe Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Hubei envoys went to win over Peng Shixi, who had not yet submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，管勾麟府軍馬公事郭恩為夏人所襲，歿於斷道塢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: Guo En, commissioner for Qin prefecture army and horse affairs, was ambushed by Xia troops and died at Duandao stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengchen: Guo En of Qinzhou was ambushed by Xia forces and killed at Duandao stockade.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔舉行磨勘法。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: implement the merit-review law.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the merit-review law was ordered into effect.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，夏國主諒祚遣人來謝使弔祭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: the Xia ruler Liangzuo sent envoys to thank the court for condolence envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuwu: Xia king Liangzuo thanked the court for its mourning mission.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以淑妃苗氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Consort Miao of the Shufei rank was made Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Shufei Lady Miao became Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，詔河北諸道總管分遣兵官教閱所部軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi, edict: Hebei circuit grand commanders were each to dispatch military officers to drill their troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinsi: Hebei grand commanders were to drill their troops by detached officers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命孫抃、張昪磨勘轉運使及提點刑獄課績。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Sun Bian and Zhang Bian were ordered to merit-review transport commissioners and punishments intendants.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Sun Bian and Zhang Bian reviewed transport and judicial commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔陝西、河北諸路經略安撫舉文武官材堪將領者各一人。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: pacification commissioners of Shaanxi and Hebei circuits were each to recommend one civil or military official fit for command.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, each Shaanxi and Hebei pacifier was to nominate one officer fit for command.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，詔：每歲賜諸道節鎮、諸州錢有差。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou, edict: annual grants of cash to circuit military commissioners and prefectures were set at graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou: annual cash grants to circuits and prefectures were fixed by grade.

sentences.zh: 命長吏選官和藥，以救民疾。

translations.literal: Magistrates were ordered to select officials to compound medicines to treat people’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects were to appoint officials to compound medicine for the sick.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命富弼等詳定《編敕》。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Fu Bi and others were ordered to compile the Compiled Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Fu Bi and others were to revise the Compiled Statutes.

sentences.zh: 庚申，錄系囚，降罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: prisoners were reviewed; crimes were reduced one degree; penal servants and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, prisoners were reviewed, cut one grade, and penal servants went free.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，策制舉人。

translations.literal: Day guihai: policy examination for classical recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, special-recruitment candidates faced the policy exam.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，置廣惠倉。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Broad Relief Granary was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Broad Relief Granary was created.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，契丹再使蕭扈、吳湛來求御容。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: the Khitan again sent Xiao Hu and Wu Zhan to request an imperial portrait.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengzi: Liao again sent Xiao Hu and Wu Zhan to seek an imperial portrait.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，遣胡宿報使契丹。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: Hu Su was sent as envoy in return to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yisi: Hu Su was dispatched on the Liao return mission.

sentences.zh: 丙午，班《祿令》。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the Salary Statutes were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Salary Statutes were issued.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，詔三司使體量判官才否以聞。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen, edict: the Three Departments commissioner was to assess the competence of his judicial assistants and report.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingshen: the finance chief was to rate his judicial aides and report.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，詔：「自今間歲貢舉，天下進士、諸科解舊額之半，置明經科，罷說書舉人。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen, edict: “From now on examinations shall be held in alternate years; jinshi and miscellaneous subjects shall present half the former quota; the Classics Examination shall be established; the Lecturer Examination shall be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen: exams were ordered every other year, jinshi quotas halved, a Classics Examination created, and the Lecturer Examination ended.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，立內降關白二府法。

translations.literal: ” Day xinhai: the law on inner edicts requiring notification of the Two Departments was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, inner edicts had to be reported to the Two Departments before execution.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西蕃瞎氈並諸族、西平州黔南道王石自品、西南蕃鶼州來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Xixia’s Zhazhan and various tribes, Shiziping of Qiannan in Xiping prefecture, and Jiming prefecture of the southwestern barbarians came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhazhan of western Tibet, Shiziping of Qiannan, and Jiming of the southwest sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊戌，鑿永通河。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day wuxu: the Yongtong Canal was dug.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 3, first month, wuxu: the Yongtong Canal was opened.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，契丹使來告其祖母哀，輟視朝七日，遣使祭奠吊慰。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao: Khitan envoys announced the mourning of their grandmother; court audiences were suspended seven days; envoys were sent to offer sacrifice, condolences, and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guimao: Liao mourned their empress dowager; court halted seven days and sent condolence envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，錄系囚，降罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day guichou: prisoners were reviewed; crimes were reduced one degree; penal servants and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, prisoners were reviewed, cut one grade, and penal servants went free.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，詔禮部貢舉。
